description: This file defines the SelectionPluginManager class, which manages Entity Reference Selection plugins in Drupal. It includes methods for instantiating plugins, retrieving plugin IDs, grouping selection handlers, and handling fallbacks.

classes.name: SelectionPluginManager
classes.description: A plugin type manager for Entity Reference Selection plugins, responsible for managing plugin instances, plugin IDs, and selection groups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin manager with namespaces, cache backend, and module handler.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a selection plugin based on provided options.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin ID for a given target type and base plugin ID, selecting the best match based on plugin weights.

methods.name: getSelectionGroups
methods.description: Returns grouped selection plugins for a specific entity type, excluding the 'broken' plugin.

methods.name: getSelectionHandler
methods.description: Gets a selection handler for a specific field definition and optional entity.

methods.name: getFallbackPluginId
methods.description: Returns the fallback plugin ID, which is 'broken' in this implementation.
